description:
Edit one flood observation (PATCH; only the fields given change).

The API checks the stored observation merged with `changes` and refuses
(400, every bad field named) rather than store a half-valid one. Photos are
not fields: attach a link with add_observation_photo_link.

changes.description: Only the fields to change, in the add_observations write shape (e.g. {"stage_m": 2.5} or a new geometry); validated by the API against the stored observation (a flood_mark or dry_point must keep a date window or a flood_name)

name: update_observation
title: Edit one flood observation
